ANNOUNCEMENT OF PERSONNEL COMMITTEE ZOOM MEETING AND AGENDA 
TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 24, 2026 
Public Session: 5:00 p.m. 
 
Please click the link below to join the webinar: 
https://hamden.zoom.us/j/85077472428?pwd=W9bEJcf57ja7JPL6a0IuUXHn6sOVVK.1  
Passcode: 105727 
 
Telephone: +1 301 715 8592, +1 305 224 1968, +1 309 205 3325, +1 312 626 6799,+1 646 558 8656  
Webinar ID: 850 7747 2428 
Passcode: 105727 
 
Note: Any member of the public may request, in writing, a physical location and “any electronic equipment necessary” to 
attend the meeting in real time. Said request shall be made to tdonnarummo@hamden.org not less than twenty-four (24) 
hours before the meeting. 
 
For those who wish to make Public Comments:  
Time will be allotted for public comments at the beginning of the meeting.  
There will be time set aside for public input during this meeting.  We ask that public comments be limited to no 
more than 1 minute in length. 
You may also submit your comment in writing.  Public comments should be sent to PublicInput@hamden.org, 
with the message's subject stating the meeting's name and date (for example, “May 12 Operations Committee 
Meeting”).  
 
Please note the following: 
• The name and Hamden address of the person submitting public comment must be included in the 
message.  
• Remarks should be brief and concise, with a maximum length of three minutes (about 450 characters).  
• Comments should start with a 2 -3 sentence summary. The summary will be read instead of the entire 
message if there is a large number of comments and reading each of them in their entirety would extend 
beyond the time allotted for public comment.  
• Public comments will be accepted up to 1 hour before the meeting begins. 
1. Call to order and roll call 
2. Additions to the agenda 
3. Public comments on information and action items 
4. Information Items:  
a. Personnel update 
 
 
5. Adjournment
